artifacts.summary: Three-phase plan applying import-only narrowings R1-R4 to seven Lean files (baseline, atomic edit batch with four-root build, post-change measurement and full gate); R5 and R6 not taken.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, adding or removing an import line in a Lean module shifts every later line, and check-module-invariants.sh C20 gates file.lean:NNN citations into that module from other files. Before planning an import narrowing, grep the citation count per target file; where a file is heavily cited (Tableau.lean, SignedFormula.lean, Axioms.lean), prefer a line-neutral edit (replace an aggregator import in place with the narrow module, or move the needed import to an uncited neighbour) over add/remove pairs. Net line changes also require typst-sync-check.sh --fix in the same commit (pre-commit hook) and --emit-inventory for README blocks; plan-file-scope-harvest.sh output names the coupled generated surfaces for a set of Lean paths.
